en.title: New name, new passport: two routes

items.text: Form signed by minister or registrar
Not valid until the wedding day

en.focal: Book tickets in the name on your passport
en.alt: Diagram of two routes to a UK passport in a married name. Apply before the wedding: up to 3 months ahead, form signed by the minister or registrar, old passport cancelled, new passport not valid until the wedding day. Apply after the wedding: send your marriage certificate, usually within 3 weeks, new passport number. Book tickets in the name on your passport
en.caption: Either route works. The one that suits you depends on when you travel next.
